hero.title: Ship fast with AI
hero.description: Full stack developer, from frontend to production backend. I use AI agents to ship faster without trading off quality and reliability. Want to work together? Reach out on LinkedIn!
hero.bulletOneTitle: Safe software, from frontend to backend
hero.bulletOneContent: I build and maintain production systems, from legacy applications to cloud-native solutions: frontend with Vue, React, and Next.js, backend with Java, Node.js, and Python, plus cloud (AWS and GCP) and observability with New Relic.
hero.bulletTwoContent: I build agents for coding, Jira board management, and workflow automation, plus skills that standardize how they work. I code with agents every day using Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot — at Intelipost, they're part of our development flow, from spec to pull request.
hero.bulletThreeContent: Undergraduate in Internet Systems (FATEC). I was a Programming Logic teaching assistant and completed an academic exchange through FATEC at the Polytechnic Institute of Bragança (Portugal), with coursework entirely in English.
